import json
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

url = "http://127.0.0.1:8050/factorize"
for quadrant in ("bottom_left", "bottom_right", "top_left", "top_right"):
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=json.dumps({"quadrant": quadrant}).encode(),
        headers={
            "Authorization": "Bearer gp-data-token-2024",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        method="POST",
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
        result = json.load(response)
        print(quadrant, response.status, result, type(result["trace"]).__name__)

request = urllib.request.Request(
    url, data=b'{"quadrant":"bottom_left"}',
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST"
)

    urllib.request.urlopen(request)
